raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: Lambda order-processor with SQS trigger, secure logging, and least-privilege IAM

Parameters:
  CodeS3Bucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket containing the Lambda deployment package
  CodeS3Key:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 key for the Lambda deployment package zip file
  CodeS3ObjectVersion:
    Type: String
    Default: ''
    Description: Optional S3 object version for the Lambda deployment package
  MemorySize:
    Type: Number
    Default: 256
    MinValue: 128
    MaxValue: 10240
    Description: Lambda memory size (MB)
  Timeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    MinValue: 1
    MaxValue: 900
    Description: Lambda timeout (seconds)
  ReservedConcurrency:
    Type: Number
    Default: 10
    MinValue: 0
    Description: Reserved concurrency for the Lambda function (0 disables invocations)
  LogRetentionDays:
    Type: Number
    Default: 30
    AllowedValues:
      - 1
      - 3
      - 5
      - 7
      - 14
      - 30
      - 60
      - 90
      - 120
      - 150
      - 180
      - 365
      - 400
      - 545
      - 731
      - 1827
      - 3653
    Description: CloudWatch Logs retention in days for the Lambda log group
  QueueMaxReceiveCount:
    Type: Number
    Default: 5
    MinValue: 1
    Description: Max receives before moving a message to the DLQ
  VisibilityTimeout:
    Type: Number
    Default: 180
    MinValue: 30
    Description: SQS queue visibility timeout (seconds). Should be >= 6x Lambda timeout.

Conditions:
  HasCodeObjectVersion: !Not [!Equals [!Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, '']]

Resources:
  LambdaEnvKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting Lambda environment variables for order-processor
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor
  LambdaEnvKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/order-processor-env
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LambdaEnvKmsKey

  LogsKmsKey:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Key
    Properties:
      Description: CMK for encrypting CloudWatch Logs for order-processor
      EnableKeyRotation: true
      KeySpec: SYMMETRIC_DEFAULT
      KeyPolicy:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: Enable IAM User Permissions
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              AWS: !Sub arn:aws:iam::${AWS::AccountId}:root
            Action: 'kms:*'
            Resource: '*'
          - Sid: AllowCloudWatchLogsUse
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: !Sub logs.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
            Action:
              - kms:Encrypt
              - kms:Decrypt
              - kms:ReEncrypt*
              - kms:GenerateDataKey*
              - kms:DescribeKey
            Resource: '*'
            Condition:
              StringEquals:
                kms:EncryptionContext:aws:logs:arn: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/order-processor
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor
  LogsKmsAlias:
    Type: AWS::KMS::Alias
    Properties:
      AliasName: alias/order-processor-logs
      TargetKeyId: !Ref LogsKmsKey

  OrderProcessorLogGroup:
    Type: AWS::Logs::LogGroup
    Properties:
      LogGroupName: /aws/lambda/order-processor
      RetentionInDays: !Ref LogRetentionDays
      KmsKeyId: !GetAtt LogsKmsKey.Arn
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderProcessorRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Properties:
      RoleName: !Sub order-processor-role-${AWS::Region}
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Sid: LambdaAssumeRole
            Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: lambda.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      Path: /
      Policies:
        - PolicyName: order-processor-logs-and-kms
          PolicyDocument:
            Version: '2012-10-17'
            Statement:
              - Sid: CreateLogGroup
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogGroup
                Resource: '*'
              - Sid: WriteFunctionLogs
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - logs:CreateLogStream
                  - logs:PutLogEvents
                Resource: !Sub arn:aws:logs:${AWS::Region}:${AWS::AccountId}:log-group:/aws/lambda/order-processor:log-stream:*
              - Sid: DecryptEnvVars
                Effect: Allow
                Action:
                  - kms:Decrypt
                  - kms:DescribeKey
                Resource: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
                Condition:
                  StringEquals:
                    kms:ViaService: !Sub lambda.${AWS::Region}.amazonaws.com
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderProcessorFunction:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::Function
    DependsOn:
      - OrderProcessorLogGroup
    Properties:
      FunctionName: order-processor
      Description: Processes order messages from SQS
      Architectures:
        - arm64
      Runtime: python3.12
      Handler: app.handler
      Role: !GetAtt OrderProcessorRole.Arn
      MemorySize: !Ref MemorySize
      Timeout: !Ref Timeout
      ReservedConcurrentExecutions: !Ref ReservedConcurrency
      TracingConfig:
        Mode: Active
      LoggingConfig:
        LogFormat: JSON
        SystemLogLevel: INFO
        ApplicationLogLevel: INFO
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO
      KmsKeyArn: !GetAtt LambdaEnvKmsKey.Arn
      EphemeralStorage:
        Size: 1024
      Code:
        S3Bucket: !Ref CodeS3Bucket
        S3Key: !Ref CodeS3Key
        S3ObjectVersion: !If [HasCodeObjectVersion, !Ref CodeS3ObjectVersion, !Ref 'AWS::NoValue']
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderQueueDLQ:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      MessageRetentionPeriod: 1209600
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderQueue:
    Type: AWS::SQS::Queue
    Properties:
      VisibilityTimeout: !Ref VisibilityTimeout
      RedrivePolicy:
        deadLetterTargetArn: !GetAtt OrderQueueDLQ.Arn
        maxReceiveCount: !Ref QueueMaxReceiveCount
      SqsManagedSseEnabled: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Project
          Value: order-processor

  OrderQueueToLambdaMapping:
    Type: AWS::Lambda::EventSourceMapping
    Properties:
      EventSourceArn: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
      FunctionName: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction
      Enabled: true
      BatchSize: 10
      MaximumBatchingWindowInSeconds: 5
      FunctionResponseTypes:
        - ReportBatchItemFailures
      ScalingConfig:
        MaximumConcurrency: 2

Outputs:
  FunctionName:
    Description: Lambda function name
    Value: !Ref OrderProcessorFunction
  FunctionArn:
    Description: Lambda function ARN
    Value: !GetAtt OrderProcessorFunction.Arn
  QueueUrl:
    Description: SQS queue URL
    Value: !Ref OrderQueue
  QueueArn:
    Description: SQS queue ARN
    Value: !GetAtt OrderQueue.Arn
  DeadLetterQueueUrl:
    Description: Dead-letter queue URL
    Value: !Ref OrderQueueDLQ
  DeadLetterQueueArn:
    Description: Dead-letter queue ARN
    Value: !GetAtt OrderQueueDLQ.Arn
